content:

캐드에서 dxf로 저장해서 파일을 열면 사진처럼 라인모양의 패턴이 아닌 사각형으로 나타납니다. 어떤 오류인지, 해결하려면 어떤 설정을 만져야하는건지 알고싶습니다.

title: AVATAR SIZING
content:
hi everyone ! i have a question regarding avatar sizing ,each time i try to manually put the measurement from my pattern making book or custom made of costumer the avatar look so weird or distorted 

another thing ; is there anyway to get the european standard measurement for the avatar directly ?

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi There. currently we do not have EU sizing. But hope to add in the future.For creating a custom avatar we recommend applying the closest ASTM size to your spec sheet and then adjust from there. Please also make sure that you are following best practices outlines on our Guide - https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/833e879ecdde47b186024115b16b90c8
Reply 1: thanks alot ❤️
content_description: This page provides guidance on accurately sizing avatars using pattern measurements and seeks information on obtaining European standard avatar measurements.

title: My modular library is empty
content:
Hi,   
I don't know why but my modular library is empty.   
How can I access the different categories and files ?   
Thanks :)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi Laura, can you check if the files are present on your computer? On Windows, the path for me is: C:\Users\Public\Documents\CLO\Assets\StylePresets Are you on Windows or Mac?
Reply 1: On mac. yes i just found the files on my computer, when i change on the setting i have the folders in my moudlar library but without files inside.
Reply 2: Do you see them if you switch from icon to list mode? (Asking because a colleague had a similar issue and it was caused by the display resolution of CLO.) Otherwise: Have you tried relinking the group? Are the files visible then?
content_description: This web page provides guidance on accessing and organizing categories and files within a modular library.

title: [Challenge] My Digital Closet Challenge Season3 #APT
content:
Hello, Creators!  
  
We are thrilled to introduce the **3rd My Digital Closet Challenge** on CONNECT, all thanks to your enthusiastic participation! 🔥🎉

  
This challenge is all about completing your stunning 3D outfit with CONNECT’s free dancing motion, turning it into an amazing lookbook animation.

* * *

For this round, we’re bringing the famous**APT Challenge** , inspired by Blackpink’s Rose and Bruno Mars!💃🕺

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/d10e8ee2460f4706b9dcbb45217865b4/images/e1caa06bdafb470ea6534333a0bc12e5Thumbnail_Rose_375x500_low2.gif)

**Don’t miss this chance to show off your style and take on this exciting dance lookbook challenge with CONNECT!**  


Check out the participation details below.😊

* * *

After uploading to SNS, leave a comment on this post with the URL to your content. We’ll check the comments and feature your work on our Instagram!**😊🎉**

You can also **show off your challenge video or link in the CONNECT community!**  
Set the post topic to Challenge and share your work with others!**🚀✨**

* * *

# **📌Challenge Details**  


  * Title : MyDigitalCloset

  * Concept: Open Theme

    * **There are no concept restrictions. Outfits with various concepts are welcome!**

    * Feel free to showcase any 3D outfits you’d like to introduce.

    * Previously released outfits are also welcome.



  * Participation Period: Ongoing

  * Participation Requirements

    * Use the motion file and avatars provided by CONNECT.

    * Collaboration is encouraged—multiple creators can work together to create a collaborative piece.

    * Upload your completed work to Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or Tiktok using the relevant hashtags.

      * #mydigitalcloset #lookbook #challenge #digitalfashion #connectofficial #clo3d #marvelousdesigner #challengebyCONNECT



  * **Participation Process**

1\. Download Motion and Avatar: Download the motion file and the avatar provided by CONNECT.

    * Motion

      * [**FV2_Dancing_APT**](https://connect.clo-set.com/detail/a1595e432258425aaa9d4e19d0dd049d)

      * [**MV2_Dancing_APT**](https://connect.clo-set.com/detail/d71bd2c6924e4818be9e60bbdad30474)

    * Avatar

      * [**Female**](https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/208988/collection/collections/220711153359e22cfc41449280e4e7245de728)

      * [**Male**](https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/208988/collection/collections/230420c9160bed61d945e6b5e3ebbe55fb03f6)

      * [**Mannequin**](https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/208988/collection/collections/2301100492be6460c740868ddf57abc64946e9)

2\. Creating Garment Animation: Apply the motion to each outfit project file and press the record button in animation mode to create the outfit animation.

    * TIP: Customize your avatar using ZACS!

3\. Rendering: Render the completed animation file.

    * We recommend an image size of 1080px * 1920px.

    * TIP : Use the [**CONNECT official Scene file**](https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/208988/collection/collections/2312DD1c848deff0094e4991a906bfc52dae0e)

4\. Editing: Edit the rendered video using an editing program.

    * You can refer to [**this video**](https://www.instagram.com/reel/C_zgG9Qv37o/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link&igsh=MzRlODBiNWFlZA==) for the editing process.

    * Feel free to use other programs if you prefer.

    * Background Music :****[**APT by Rose**](https://youtu.be/ekr2nIex040?si=IcN-y5xcN8OBLUf6)

5\. Upload to SNS: Upload your finished work to Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or TikTok.

    * Include the following hashtags

      * #mydigitalcloset #lookbook #challenge #digitalfashion #connectofficial #clo3d #marvelousdesigner #challengebyCONNECT

6\. Complete Participation

    * Once uploaded to SNS, leave a comment on **this post** with your email address and the URL to your content.

      * Example : Participation Complete / [www.example.com](http://www.example.com)

    * You can also **show off your challenge video or link in the CONNECT community!**

      * Set the post topic to Challenge and share your work with others!




* * *

  
Challenge Enquiry

1\. Direct message on [**Instagram**](https://www.instagram.com/closet_connect_official/)  
2\. Comments on **this page**

* * *

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/d10e8ee2460f4706b9dcbb45217865b4/images/a720c3d52af9406a8a828b70c9e6bbdbMotion_Challenge_FHD.00_00_21_12.%EC%8A%A4%ED%8B%B8%20003.png)

** _Now it’s time to showcase your_**  
** _amazing digital wardrobe to the world!_ 🚀✨**

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/d10e8ee2460f4706b9dcbb45217865b4/images/a18e4e0aa35e4086a5313958a57e27deReels%20thumbnail_Final.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/d10e8ee2460f4706b9dcbb45217865b4/images/a2d187637eee458e8cf3efc3367e05d0community%20thumbnail.png)
content_description: Join the 3rd My Digital Closet Challenge to create and share stunning 3D outfit animations using CONNECT’s free dance motions and showcase your digital fashion creativity with the community!
